crons.comment: Safety net only. A queued run is nudged awake immediately by the action that created it (lib/jobs/trigger.ts); this collects anything that nudge missed — a run whose worker died, or one queued while a deploy was in flight. On Hobby this fires once a day, which is enough for a backstop and would not be enough as the primary trigger.

ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "blm-cloud-release" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
